title: Юнитэкономика Ozon по товарам, заказанным за выбранную дату
scope: Specification for another implementer; not an executable or installed matrix template
safe_utterances: Юнитэкономика на Озоне за 4 ноября 2026, себестоимость 250 рублей, без налога
Рассчитай экономику заказов на Озоне за вчера

slots.date: required ISO date or resolved relative date
slots.unit_cost_rub: optional user input; no default; 250 only when user supplies 250
slots.tax: optional user rule/base/rate; absent -> excluded and stated
slots.own_costs: optional user input; absent -> excluded and stated

answer_contract.currency_policy: RUB or separate currency groups; never mix currencies
answer_contract.completeness: A report with estimates is forecast; missing required advertising or expense scope -> PARTIAL with exact reason, no final net profit
tables: A: counterfactual all ordered items fulfilled, no cancellations/returns
B: current order cohort including cancellation/return losses
answer_contract.unit_cost_display: user input stays 250 per applicable goods item if input250; allocated cost per all ordered items is separate and must not be relabelled as unit purchase cost

source_bindings.qualification: Use active API schema, pagination and order creation date; do not select by delivery date
Same order-date and identity rules; cancelled_after_ship alone is not physical-handover proof

source_bindings.join: exact posting / order + SKU + quantity and currency; reject ambiguous allocation; keep actual accrual date separate from original order date

source_bindings.rule: CPO and CPC mandatory; reconcile sources; include once, not finance + Performance added twice
whole-store date expense is period allocation, not exact original-order attribution
exact unit and posting linkage; partial child cancellation is not a second whole order

expressions: N_ordered = SUM(original products.quantity), before removing cancellations; not COUNT(sales)
V_all = SUM(seller order unit_price * quantity); buyer discounted payment is a different metric
V_remaining = V_all - cancelled seller value - qualified returned seller value
commission_estimate = SUM(applicable seller line value * scheme commission_percent / 100)
tariff_midpoint = (API minimum + API maximum) / 2; only a published tariff interval, never probability of an event
row_percent = expense_total / seller_value_of_same_scenario * 100; zero denominator -> not defined, not zero
goods_cost = user_unit_cost * applicable_remaining_ordered_quantity; cancellation revenue=0 and cancellation goods_cost=0
result = seller_value - unique marketplace expenses - advertising - included goods_cost - included own_costs - included tax
rub_per_item = row_total / explicitly printed scenario quantity; do not replace order cohort with day financial sales count

deterministic_expense_rules.precedence: exact matched actual net charge/reversal replaces the same service estimate; one service is counted once
deterministic_expense_rules.normal_order: Forecast full fulfillment using scheme-specific commission percent, direct tariff midpoint, last-mile API amount, FBS first-mile midpoint, API acquiring amount when no actual exists
deterministic_expense_rules.cancelled_revenue_and_goods: both zero; do not add the cancelled seller value to result or consume goods purchase cost merely because order was placed
deterministic_expense_rules.cancelled_known_no_handover: unperformed direct/last-mile/handling/reverse forecast=0; do not erase actual contradictory debits; show discrepancy

cancelled_unknown_stage.quantity: cancelled physical units, never number of baskets or all items of a partial cancellation
cancelled_unknown_stage.human_label: Оценка обратной логистики по тарифу API
cancelled_unknown_stage.other_transport: Conservative full-route estimate when applicability is unknown: direct tariff midpoint + API last-mile amount + FBS first-mile midpoint; matched actual service replaces its estimate. This is an explicit upper-cost scenario, not proof all services occurred.

deterministic_expense_rules.missing_return_tariff: If API has no amount, look up official tariff for same scheme/category/date; use midpoint only for a real min/max tariff interval. If still absent -> missing_return_tariff with endpoint/field/reason, PARTIAL, never an invented zero
deterministic_expense_rules.acquiring: Use actual matched amount, else explicit acquiring API amount; never infer fixed percent from total debit or prorate a current amount silently
deterministic_expense_rules.ads: Include all dated CPO and CPC once; no automatic refund solely from cancellation or return; matched documented credit reduces cost
deterministic_expense_rules.returns: Keep separate from cancellations; account exact returned quantity, refund and reverse/processing costs. Recoverable returned goods do not become a permanent lost purchase cost; damaged/lost goods write-off is a separate evidenced expense
deterministic_expense_rules.other_expenses: All source expense types must be classified: acceptance, storage, delivery, processing, acquiring, paid services, penalties, adjustments and other debits. Unmapped type -> explicit unresolved amount/reason; never silently omit
deterministic_expense_rules.overhead: Whole-store advertising/storage for date allocated once to selected cohort; print scope. Product/store filters require qualified allocation, not the full store debit for each SKU
deterministic_expense_rules.refunds: Use actual debit/credit signs or a verified official rule; missing CPO refund rule -> no invented credit
deterministic_expense_rules.tariff_date: Current tariff is forecast input, never relabelled historical actual; record retrieval date and effective period if known
deterministic_expense_rules.percentages: No constants 49.83%, 62.91%, 67.03%, 9.25% or 4.86%; they are report results. Even commission50% must come from returned product/scheme tariff, not hardcode

errors.no_advertising: PARTIAL_ADVERTISING_UNAVAILABLE: name failed endpoint/status and next step; do not accept advertising-free template
errors.provider_429: keep error message/retry-after; shared ledger; no empty success or zero
errors.no_orders: complete order source may prove empty cohort; show quantities0 and undefined per-unit/percent
errors.scope_mismatch: do not compare different order cohorts or a financial-day expense pool as final order-level actual
errors.http200_empty: check period, readiness and pagination; empty finance response is not proof of zero lifetime costs

dependencies: qualified order dataset and exact cancellation quantities
numeric acceptance and Yandex Dialogs retest
negative_cases: one partially cancelled child does not duplicate original
50% seller-price commission is not 50% buyer-card price
one of rates48% must not become all50%
delivery total + its components not added twice
finance ads + Performance ads not added twice
unknown cancel stage -> return tariff without manual block
no denominator switch to12 realized items
429/missing ads yields reason, not blank answer
validation_state: Candidate only: synthetic gold supplied; production operator/source coverage and independent acceptance still required
